entries.text: You see a technician. He is working diligently for the Unity and the Master.
entries.source_text: You see a technician. He is working diligently for the Unity and the Master.

entries.text: We do the work of the Master.
entries.source_text: We do the work of the Master.

entries.text: We do the work of the Master, and we cannot be interrupted!
entries.source_text: We do the work of the Master, and we cannot be interrupted!

entries.text: Master! An intruder!
entries.source_text: Master! An intruder!

entries.text: You see Viscious, a super mutant leader. He looks mean.
entries.source_text: You see Viscious, a super mutant leader. He looks mean.

entries.text: You see a mean-looking super mutant.
entries.source_text: You see a mean-looking super mutant.

entries.text: The will of the Master prevails. What news do you have for me?
entries.source_text: The will of the Master prevails. What news do you have for me?

entries.text: Hng!
entries.source_text: Hng!

entries.text: Uh, the war goes well.
entries.source_text: Uh, the war goes well.

entries.text: I have a message for the Master from his Lieutenant. I must see the Master now.
entries.source_text:
I have a message for the Master from his Lieutenant. I must see the
 Master now.

entries.text: The only news that I have is that you're about to become fertilizer.
entries.source_text: The only news that I have is that you're about to become fertilizer.

entries.text: An intruder!
entries.source_text: An intruder!

entries.text: Your manner betrays you, intruder. I will end the threat here.
entries.source_text: Your manner betrays you, intruder. I will end the threat here.

entries.text: You cannot be serious. In fact, you must be lying.
entries.source_text: You cannot be serious. In fact, you must be lying.

entries.text: Uh, yeah, so what?
entries.source_text: Uh, yeah, so what?

entries.text: I'm not. The Lieutenant could not trust this message to the usual method. I have to see the Master right now! There is no time to waste!
entries.source_text:
I'm not. The Lieutenant could not trust this message to the usual
 method. I have to see the Master right now! There is no time to waste!

entries.text: Then use the door, and beware the Corridor. I assume that you have your protection in place?
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Of course. Thank you. Unity prevails.
entries.source_text: Of course. Thank you. Unity prevails.

entries.text: No, not really. Should I?
entries.source_text: No, not really. Should I?

entries.text: Of course! You cannot hope to pass the Corridor without it. What did you do with your nullifier!
entries.source_text:
Of course! You cannot hope to pass the Corridor without it. What did
 you do with your nullifier!

entries.text: I left it in my other robes.
entries.source_text: I left it in my other robes.

entries.text: The Lieutenant did not have time to give me one.
entries.source_text: The Lieutenant did not have time to give me one.

entries.text: Ah, humor, I like that. [pauses] I do not have one, obviously. You need to go get one from the braindrains on the second level. Unity prevails.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Then he was a fool, or you are not who you seem to be. What is it?
entries.source_text: Then he was a fool, or you are not who you seem to be. What is it?

entries.text: Obviously, he is a fool.
entries.source_text: Obviously, he is a fool.

entries.text: The second part.
entries.source_text: The second part.

entries.text: Move alone and continue your mission. I haven't the time for you.
